The 1 PM, 4 PM, and 6/7 PM return-trip checks started on 24–25 Nov, so those slots are still coming in — except one return: Himadri to Ballupur on Tue 24 Nov at about 7:10 PM IST took 46 min via Raipur Rd. The 25 Nov evening check had not run when this site was first published.

alternatives.kanwaliVsGms: Both driving times were recorded on 11 evenings. Kanwali Rd was faster 3 times (13, 18 and 19 Nov, usually by a minute). GMS Rd was faster 4 times (9, 14, 15 and 22 Nov). They tied 4 times (16, 17, 21 and 23 Nov). On several other evenings only GMS Rd was listed (including the 14 min jams on 12 and 14 Nov). On 11 Nov only Kanwali Rd (9 min) was a clear driving option in the report.
alternatives.clockTowerRoutes: When both were timed, Chakrata Rd (sometimes with Omkar Rd) was usually as fast or faster: 15, 19, 20, 21, 22 and 24 Nov evenings, and 13 Nov when Chakrata Rd and Omkar Rd took 17 min versus 20 on direct Chakrata Rd. Shaheed Kashmir Singh Rd and Kaulagarh Rd were clearly faster on 11 Nov (18 vs 20) and 23 Nov (18 vs 21), and both options took 23 min on 18 Nov. On the two 27 min evenings (17 and 21 Nov) Chakrata Rd had a long delay; Kaulagarh Rd was not better on 21 Nov (28 min).
